title: Disney Ten Magical Years Ornament Once Upon a Classic Collectors Club 2002
descriptionText: The Disney Ten Magical Years Ornament is a special collectors' item from 2002 celebrating a decade of iconic Disney moments. Made in China, this officially licensed Disney product features a whimsical design that captures the magic of the Disney franchise. Perfect for adding a touch of Disney charm to any holiday decor or collection, this ornament encapsulates the timeless stories and characters that have made Disney a beloved staple in popular culture.
